attributes.action: Revoke under performing NHS food contracts and switch to a more capable supplier
attributes.additional_details: It recently came to my attention that there is at least one NHS cafe that as recently as May 2026 has been awarded a 0 food hygeine score, with what appears to be poor quality food. Whips Cross hospital has a cafe and restaraunt ran by the company Elior and whilst they may be one of the largest contract catering companies in the UK, I personally believe that NHS workers and visitors to the hospital deserve to eat much better food cooked in much more sanitary kitchens.
attributes.background: It is all too common for food canteens within the NHS to provide poor quality food in low hygenine rated environments, I would like to propose looking at alternative suppliers for this who already provide high quality affordable healthy meals to the public, in good hygeine kitchens for example IKEA.

rejection.details: It is for individual NHS trusts to decide how they manage their catering contracts, not the UK Government or Parliament.
